description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WinForms application, with Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Protected mail-merge fields remain unchanged when a paste would replace only part of a token, for native and managed paste. Ordinary text and whole-field replacements undo in one step. No public API changes.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
